【實用資訊】
For a good start to the semester at KIT, all incoming students are allowed to participate in a three-week German language course (beginners and intermediate A2-B2) before the semester begins.
This course is not a substitute for the certificate of the German language level required for the application
. The course fee is 75 euros for international students. Students will get 4 ECTS if they attend 80% of the course and pass the exam. During the semester, the
Studienkolleg
at KIT offers free German language courses for all students enrolled at KIT.
Health insurance coverage is mandatory for your
entire stay
in Germany, with unlimited coverage. You can either obtain private health insurance in your home country before arriving in Karlsruhe or take out a German public health insurance before or after arrival. However, we strongly recommend choosing
German public health insurance
, as many private policies from non-EU countries may not be accepted. Without valid insurance, enrolment at the university is not possible.
Students from partner universities
pay a charge for the Studierendenwerk
of about 92 € per semester. This includes reduced student prices at the university restaurant, transportation reductions, and accident insurance.
Cost of Living
官方連結：https://www.stk.kit.edu/english/index.php；https://www.intl.kit.edu/istudies/15337.php；https://www.sle.kit.edu/english/imstudium/703.php；https://www.daad.de/en/study-and-research-in-germany/plan-your-studies/costs-of-education-and-living/

【住宿資訊】
KIT reserves rooms in
student residences
for students from partner universities.
Accommodation is guaranteed
if students adhere to the application procedure and deadlines. Details are sent by email after admission to KIT.
The furnished single rooms cost between €250 and €350 per month and are rented for fixed lease periods:
October to March (winter semester)
and/or
April to September (summer semester)
. Please note that these rental periods are non-negotiable, and no alternative move-in or move-out dates are available.
Please note that accommodation prices on the private market are significantly higher than those in student dorms, and there is also
a risk of scams
. For this reason, we highly recommend applying for a room in a student dorm through us.
For students attending the
pre-semester German language course
(starting mid-September in the winter semester/mid-March in the summer semester), we recommend reserving accommodation in youth hostels, hostels, or Airbnb for the two weeks before the rental period of guaranteed rooms in the student residences. This must be arranged privately, as KIT unfortunately cannot assist with finding housing on the private market.

【實用資訊】
For a good start to the semester at KIT, all incoming students are allowed to participate in a three-week German language course (beginners and intermediate A2-B2) before the semester begins.
This course is not a substitute for the certificate of the German language level required for the application
. The course fee is 75 euros for international students. Students will get 4 ECTS if they attend 80% of the course and pass the exam. During the semester, the
Studienkolleg
at KIT offers free German language courses for all students enrolled at KIT.
Health insurance coverage is mandatory for your
entire stay
in Germany, with unlimited coverage. You can either obtain private health insurance in your home country before arriving in Karlsruhe or take out a German public health insurance before or after arrival. However, we strongly recommend choosing
German public health insurance
, as many private policies from non-EU countries may not be accepted. Without valid insurance, enrolment at the university is not possible.
Students from partner universities
pay a charge for the Studierendenwerk
of about 92 € per semester. This includes reduced student prices at the university restaurant, transportation reductions, and accident insurance.
Cost of Living
官方連結：https://www.stk.kit.edu/english/index.php；https://www.intl.kit.edu/istudies/15337.php；https://www.sle.kit.edu/english/imstudium/703.php；https://www.daad.de/en/study-and-research-in-germany/plan-your-studies/costs-of-education-and-living/

【住宿資訊】
KIT reserves rooms in
student residences
for students from partner universities.
Accommodation is guaranteed
if students adhere to the application procedure and deadlines. Details are sent by email after admission to KIT.
The furnished single rooms cost between €250 and €350 per month and are rented for fixed lease periods:
October to March (winter semester)
and/or
April to September (summer semester)
. Please note that these rental periods are non-negotiable, and no alternative move-in or move-out dates are available.
Please note that accommodation prices on the private market are significantly higher than those in student dorms, and there is also
a risk of scams
. For this reason, we highly recommend applying for a room in a student dorm through us.
For students attending the
pre-semester German language course
(starting mid-September in the winter semester/mid-March in the summer semester), we recommend reserving accommodation in youth hostels, hostels, or Airbnb for the two weeks before the rental period of guaranteed rooms in the student residences. This must be arranged privately, as KIT unfortunately cannot assist with finding housing on the private market.

Please note that Human Medicine and Veterinary Medicine are NOT open to exchange students.
With few exceptions, all undergraduate programs are open for exchange students. Enrollment in the following courses is subject to availability of lab classes and to prior approval by the institute/department:
Biochemistry, Bioinformatics and Biology
. Restrictions apply in
Pharmacy, Law, Business Administration and Economics
.
The Law Department prefers direct exchange students from institutions who also accept law students. There are only
very few places
available for other exchange programs.
The following
master's degree programs
are open for postgraduate exchange students without restriction: modern German literature, philosophy, and political science.
All other master's degree programs are restricted
and need prior approval from the institute/department.

【實用資訊】
Language courses
for exchange students
VISA application information
Exchange students must have comprehensive
health insurance
valid in Germany for enrolment as a fulltime student at FU Berlin AND for obtaining a residence permit.
Exchange students are exempt from university fees, but they still need to pay the so-called semester ticket and social fees of approx. € 330 per semester.These fees are not paid to the university, but instead go to the student union and cover the cost of a public transportation ticket for the Berlin metropolitan area for the entire semester. Students will be asked to pay the fees before arrival in Berlin as part of the enrollment process.
Freie Universität Berlin offers two scholarships for a period of ten months (1 October 2027 – 31 July 2028) with the following terms:
- € 800 as a monthly grant;
- € 500 health insurance allowance per semester;
- Reimbursement of student fees (approx. € 300 per semester);
- A waiver of registration fees.
官方連結：https://www.sprachenzentrum.fu-berlin.de/en/sprachangebot/sprachen/deutsch/index.html；https://www.fu-berlin.de/en/studium/international/studium_fu/einreise_aufenthalt/visum/index.html；https://www.fu-berlin.de/en/studium/international/studium_fu/einreise_aufenthalt/krankenversicherung/index.html

application_info:
【注意事項】
交換學校一覽表所列之語言能力為該校之最低門檻要求，同學需自行確認語言能力是否符合該校修課要求、查詢是否有相對應的系所及足夠的課程可供選讀、能否達到該校之每學期修課學分數要求、以及是否具備相關領域之背景知識，若未達標準，該校有權拒收。
Website
of incoming exchange student information.
Website
of course information.
Most Bachelor programmes are NOT open for exchange students because teaching language is Swedish. Only 1 Bachelor programme Information and Communication Technology is open for exchange, most exchange students no matter which level they are studying at home university, they might have to choose courses at Master's level at KTH.
Architecture programme is NOT open for exchange student.
It is advised that students make a Learning Agreement/Study plan including only 30 credits per semester. KTH cannot guarantee student's admittance to courses exceeding this 30 credits limit. 30 credits is a full time study load and is also a requirement in order to get a Residence Permit for studies in Sweden.
【居留證注意事項】
瑞典居留證和交換期間修讀學分數息息相關。請確實遵守姊妹校選課規定，勿隨意退選課程，以免影響居留證效力。相關資訊請參考
瑞典移民局網站
。

【實用資訊】
Language courses for international and exchange students
Cost of living: SEK 10,584-14,950 per month
It is very important that all international students have
complete insurance coverage
for their entire stay in Sweden. Consequently, KTH asks all international students to have a complete insurance cover when arriving to KTH. Important areas that the insurance should cover are: personal injury, medical and dental care, accidents, personal belongings (luggage etc.), liability coverage, legal expense coverage, home transportation (in case of injury or illness). As a compliment the student is covered by the Student IN insurance provided by Kammarkollegiet.
官方連結：https://www.kth.se/en/larande/sprak/utbildning/malgrupper/internationella-studenter-1.1180077；https://www.kth.se/en/student/studier/newatkth/exchange-student/insurance-1.366220

【臺大來源更新，2026-10-14】
臺大116-1／2027–28已公告1 學年名額（最多 2 人次）。名額為學年單位，一學期計0.5；人次是最多人數，不保證錄取。可交換一學期或一學年，限本校第一學期出國；選填系統開放及其他條件仍須確認。

2026-10-11接待校公開來源補查；以下各項按各自文件期間及校區作參考，不能視為116-1最終甄選資格或截止提醒。

保險與簽證參考：incoming exchange由Student IN投保，條款自2025/7/1版本起；全校人身事故保障限校內及往返途中，仍應逐項核對校外醫療與房東家財保險要求，不當作全情境完整保障。

來源：https://www.kth.se/en/student/studier/newatkth/exchange-student/insurance-1.366220

住宿參考：KTH住房服務按學生群組區分：部分保證、部分僅有空房才提供、部分须自行找房。不可由服務存在推定臺大交換生自動保證；需讀交換生類別資格與申請頁。
適用範圍：接待校公開指南；未明列適用學年，校區與課程依錄取結果；查閱：2026-10-11T08:33:49.764054+00:00
來源：https://www.kth.se/en/student/studier/housing/housing-services-1.374952

課程參考：KTH一般交換選30ECTS/學期，多數需在母校協議學科並符合各課先修；建築須專屬協議及完成三年，有固定學習計畫；不將一般英授碩士多課數視為全部課可選。

來源：https://www.kth.se/en/studies/exchange/general/courses

來源：https://www.kth.se/en/student/studier/schema/kommande-lasar-1.1202159

接待校資格參考：KTH exchange限協議partner在籍、不收free movers；一般須母校program已完成至少兩年、preferably more且above-average grades，Architecture須三年；doubledegree另需專agreement及三年，internships不給academiccredits且不可選課，不能混入一般exchange資格。
適用範圍：KTH未標年度incoming nondegree exchange，與doubledegree/dualMaster/internship分清；查閱：2026-10-11T08:33:52.578085+00:00
來源：https://www.kth.se/en/studies/exchange/general

接待校語言參考：KTH exchange不要求official language test results，強烈建議English相當European B2。B2是推薦，不得改為硬線，Swedish course placement或fee-paying degree語言班也不是初申英語要求。
適用範圍：KTH未標年度incoming nondegree exchange，與doubledegree/dualMaster/internship分清；查閱：2026-10-11T08:33:52.578085+00:00
來源：https://www.kth.se/en/studies/exchange/general

課程參考：KTH exchange每semester應選30ECTS，majority credits須在母校agreement選派studyarea並滿足每課prereq；Architecture須專exchangeagreement與三年completedstudy且固定plan。UG主要Swedish、Master主要English，不能把所有English master course都當UG保證可修。
適用範圍：KTH未標年度incoming exchange選課；查閱：2026-10-11T08:33:44.694189+00:00
來源：https://www.kth.se/en/studies/exchange/general/courses

適用範圍：KTH未標年度incoming exchange在學語言課流程；查閱：2026-10-11T08:33:45.668184+00:00

來源：https://www.kth.se/en/student/studier/housing/eligibility-and-application-1.809659

來源：https://www.kth.se/en/student/studier/newatkth/exchange-student/insurance-1.366220

Useful information about courses for exchange students is listed
here

60 credits should be selected in order to have reserve options.
Please note, the Swedish Migration Agency requires students to be accepted to full–time studies to issue residence permits for non-EU/EES students. Full-time study means
30 credits (or higher education points) per term
. You cannot receive a residence permit for distance learning or online courses.
Restricted subject areas for exchange students:
Business Studies – Entry requirements vary considerably and are generally high. Admission to Master level courses requires a finished Bachelor's degree majoring in Business Studies. Limited spaces on certain courses.
Biomedicine – A very strong academic background in the subject is required. Limited spaces.
Economics – Courses are not available to exchange students.
Government - Course availability is limited, particularly for courses with general entry requirements.
History – Some courses have limited capacity.
Immunology – A very strong academic background in the subject is required. Very limited spaces on courses.
Law – Students must have completed at least two years of prior full-time Law studies. Places on specific courses cannot be guaranteed. Students who meet the academic requirements can normally be offered Law courses but should be flexible regarding course selection, as the courses offered may differ from those initially requested.
Medicine – Clinical Medicine courses are not available through university-wide exchange agreements. Students applying for other Medicine courses must have a strong academic background in Medicine. No entry-level courses are taught in English.
Musicology – Limited course availability (if any), with high entry requirements.
Natural Sciences including Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Engineering – There are few to no entry-level courses taught in English. Students must have a very strong academic background in the relevant subject and meet the specific entry requirements. Very limited spaces on almost all courses.
Pharmacy - A very strong academic background is required. Limited spaces.
Philosophy – A limited selection of courses is available with high entry requirements.
Psychology – Only a small number of basic-level courses are taught in English with extremely limited spaces available.
Physiology and Anatomy – Courses are not available to students on university-wide exchange agreements.
Sociology – None to very few courses available, with high entry requirements, depending on the semester.
Courses offered within regular Bachelor's and Master's programmes, that are not included in the Course Catalogue for Exchange Students, are generally not available to exchange students.
Please note: there is NO add-and-drop period at Uppsala University.

Bachelor/undergraduate students must have completed at least 2 semesters or equivalent before the exchange stay and are expected to attend the majority of their courses in the same or similar subject they study at their home university.
Exchange students are expected to choose courses amounting to around 20 ECTS in the same or a similar subject they study at their home university.
Restrictions:
Cross-faculty course booking is allowed, however, students should attend most courses in their major and minor(s).
Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences: no cross-level booking.
English Department (English Language and Literature): Students who are not enrolled in English Language and Literature at their home university can only take lectures offered by the English Department.
Department of Biology: Only students who study Biology, Biochemistry or Biomedicine at their home university are allowed to take courses in Biology, Biochemistry or Biomedicine. Also, Block Courses are closed to exchange students.
Department of Psychology: Only students who study Psychology as a major at their home university are allowed to take courses offered by the Department of Psychology.
Faculty of Law: Students taking courses at the Faculty of Law must have completed 4 semesters at their home university before the begin of their exchange stay at UZH.
Medicine NOT open to exchange students

Most courses for bachelor students are taught in German.
Most classes in English are at Master level. Bachelor exchange students are welcome to also sign up for Master courses (there may be some exceptions regarding Master seminars).
The language of instruction is mentioned in the course catalogue.
Students should have sufficient proficiency of German and/or English to be able to follow lectures and written exams (CEFR level B2; CEFR level C1 for courses at the English Department).
For PhD students we have special requirements: PhD students are asked to find a professor at the University of Bern, who will act as their supervisor during the time of their stay in Bern. Only with this support, we can accept exchange students on PhD level.
For exchange students, a credit load of 20-25 ECTS/semester is recommended.

.

Study Abroad at Sussex
How to choose your modules
Standard credit load: 60 Sussex credits per semester (3 or 4 classes).
MODULES
: Many students seem confused with our terminology and select modules for incorrect terms. They should also check the modules listed in the Study Abroad Guide, at times students seem to be using a list of modules approved by the home university and some of these lists contain modules that are no longer taught.
Students coming for autumn term only
can only select modules listed as 'autumn teaching', they cannot take part of a full year module so any modules listed as 'autumn & spring teaching' should not be selected. Some students believe that these modules are taught in the autumn and then repeated in the spring but this is not correct, they run over two terms.
Students coming for spring/summer
should only select modules listed as 'spring teaching'.
Students coming for the full year
are free to select modules taught in any term
All module choices are of course subject to any prerequisites that may apply.

課程資訊請參考
此連結
Graduate students can only undertake coursework, not research, during their exchange program at the University of Adelaide.
It is not possible to choose a combination of undergraduate and postgraduate courses.
If a student wishes to take undergraduate courses as a master's student, we can accommodate this. In general, there are more undergraduate course options compared to postgraduate.Students should review choosing a course website to determine if their required study area is available.
Study areas not open to Exchange students include but not limited to: Biomedical Studies, Dentistry, Indonesian, Italian, Medical Studies, Modern Greek, Museum and Curatorial Studies, Music Theatre, Nursing, Occupational Therapy, Oral Health, Physiotherapy, Speech Pathology, and etc. (Unavailable Courses = courses not offered to Exchange students.)
Courses with (but not limited to) a course code ending in RG, NA, UAC are NOT available to exchange students.
To check if a course you have selected is available to Study Abroad or Exchange students, visit the Course Outline list. Navigate to study area that you are interested in, then navigate to the course that you are interested in and click on the 'General Course Information' accordion.
Some courses may have pre-requisites, limited availability or may require pre-approval by the School/Faculty. It's students' responsibility to ensure that they have appropriate academic background.
(Restricted Courses = courses may be available but have prerequisites and/or limited availability.)
The faculties will look at the student's transcript and course descriptions from the home university to determine the students' suitability for enrolment into the desired courses.
Courses from the following areas require additional approval prior to enrolment: Criminology, Education, Health Sciences, Languages, Law, MBA, Media, Music, Sciences.
There are two categories of English requirements for entry, dependent on the courses chosen:
General Academic Level: Most undergraduate and postgraduate courses.
Higher English Language Level (including but not limited to): Education, Medicine, Animal & Veterinary Science, Law and MBA.
Minimum / Maximum academic workload per semester: At least 9 units (usually 3 courses). This is considered a 75% workload, but meets full time enrolment requirements for visa purposes. Max 12 units = 100% workload.

Course restrictions

Undergraduate

Postgraduate

接待校資格參考：Monash2027接收規則：學士在交換開始前完成一年，平均60%或GPA3.0/4.0或ECTS C／母校等值；碩士通常完成一年，同校同領域接續學位有例外。仍須符合英文與課程先修，不能取代臺大甄選條件。
適用範圍：Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認，PDF第2頁；查閱：2026-10-11T10:18:24.472308+00:00
來源：https://studyabroad.ntu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Exchange-Student-Fact-Sheet-2027.pdf

接待校文件參考：2027Monash需歷次／現校正式成績單及必要英文認證翻譯、英文能力證明（適用者）、護照個資頁、所選課先修證明／英文課綱；資料齊全後才評估申請。交換生必須等母校提名釋出專用表，誤用direct apply會轉為自費Study Abroad。
適用範圍：Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認，PDF第3頁；查閱：2026-10-11T10:18:24.472308+00:00
來源：https://studyabroad.ntu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Exchange-Student-Fact-Sheet-2027.pdf

接待校期限參考：Monash2027 Exchange接收申請：Semester1截止2026/11/1，Semester2截止2027/4/1，澳洲／馬來西亞同日；Study Abroad截止不同。這是接待校流程，不是臺大116-1報名期限，無法由此推定臺大名額。
適用範圍：Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認，PDF第4頁；查閱：2026-10-11T10:18:24.472308+00:00
來源：https://studyabroad.ntu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Exchange-Student-Fact-Sheet-2027.pdf

行事曆參考：Monash2027必到交換orientation：Australia Semester1抵達2/15、Semester2抵達7/19；Malaysia為2/17與7/14。交換orientation在全校orientation前一週、上課前兩週，無法按澳洲日期替代馬來西亞。
適用範圍：Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認，PDF第5頁；查閱：2026-10-11T10:18:24.472308+00:00
來源：https://studyabroad.ntu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Exchange-Student-Fact-Sheet-2027.pdf

課程參考：2027Monash校区與課程限制：Clayton工程／理／學士法、Caulfield藝設建築、Parkville藥學；Malaysia需整學期在該校區。其他Alfred/Gippsland/Prato/Singapore/Suzhou地點不可選；查Handbook是否開放exchange，通常每學期四課中最多一課線上，須6–8課備選。
適用範圍：Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認，PDF第2頁；查閱：2026-10-11T10:18:24.472308+00:00
來源：https://studyabroad.ntu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Exchange-Student-Fact-Sheet-2027.pdf

保險與簽證參考：Monash2027澳洲校區錄取接受與適用OSHC繳付證明後才出CoE，標準為subclass500 Non-Award；OSHC只基本醫療，不含國際旅行／行李等。Malaysia另需醫療保險付款後進行簽證；簽證由身分與當期政府規則決定。
適用範圍：Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認，PDF第5頁；查閱：2026-10-11T10:18:24.472308+00:00
來源：https://studyabroad.ntu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Exchange-Student-Fact-Sheet-2027.pdf

住宿參考：Monash2027澳洲住房可在未獲offer前申請校內、免申請費並標Monash Abroad；按先到先得配房。校外由校方提供搜尋與租屋支援，非保證。Malaysia住房與澳洲條件不得混用。
適用範圍：Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認，PDF第6頁；查閱：2026-10-11T10:18:24.472308+00:00
來源：https://studyabroad.ntu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Exchange-Student-Fact-Sheet-2027.pdf

費用參考：Monash2027文件区分：Exchange須母校雙邊提名，學費續向母校付；Study Abroad向Monash付。生活費链接主要為完整學位國際生，交換可能不同，未取一般學位價格作個人交換報價。
適用範圍：Monash交換生Fact Sheet2027；Australia/Malaysia校區須由雙邊協議、提名與申請確認，PDF第1頁；查閱：2026-10-11T10:18:24.472308+00:00
來源：https://studyabroad.ntu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Exchange-Student-Fact-Sheet-2027.pdf

but some are restricted
, have limited entry, or have earlier application deadlines.
Students must be enrolled in a minimum of 45 points in order to be considered a full-time student. 6
0 points (3-4 courses) per trimester is the maximum
and recommended course load for exchange students.
1 point at Victoria University of Wellington is equivalent to 0.5 ECTS/0.25 US Credits. 1 point typically requires 10 hours of student work (lectures, labs, study time etc).
Information about courses offered each year can be found on our
Course finder
and
Study Abroad and Exchange
pages.

此連結
Apply online for an Exchange Student visa through
Immigration NZ
.

Undergraduate students:
Entry Requirements
Postgraduate students:
Entry Requirements
NTU students may be able to take postgraduate courses only if course prerequisites are met and accepted by the faculty.
The Exchange programme is restricted to course work only and does not include thesis writing and supervision.
Students who wish to take a full-year course load at postgraduate level
are advised to apply as an international student
to the University of Auckland for a one-year postgraduate programme.
Not available to exchange students (including but not limited to): School of Nursing, Medicine, Surgery, Pharmacy, Optometry, MBA, and Courses ending with the letters F, H.
Many courses in Fine Arts, Architecture, Design and Music require the submission of supplementary information.
Stage I Engineering courses (ENGGEN 115, ENGGEN 121, ENGGEN 131, ENGGEN 140, ENGGEN 150, ENGSCI 111, ELECTENG 101, CHEMMAT 121) are not open to exchange students.
Exchange students are considered “non-degree” students at the University of Auckland and are enrolled in the COPEX (Certificate of Proficiency for Exchange) programme.
Students should apply for “concession” to enrol in courses that require Auckland faculty approval. In this process, faculties assess whether their prior study meets relevant course prerequisites and notify them accordingly. In some occasions, they may be asked to provide course outlines/syllabi in English for courses equivalent to Auckland prerequisite requirements. ...read more
The standard course load for full-time study is
50-60 points per semester
or
100-120 points per year
. Most courses are weighted 15 points and students generally take four courses per semester.
Course schedules are published and enrolments are open on 1 November for the subsequent year (both Semester 1 and 2).
Exchange students may select courses across different disciplines provided if they meet course prerequisites and the courses are not restricted (see “course restrictions”).
Visa requirements: Exchange students must apply for “Exchange Student Visa” to Immigration New Zealand and obtain their student visa prior to entering New Zealand. They should not enter New Zealand on a visitor visa.
Mandatory health and travel insurance:
All enrolled international students are required to have approved
health and travel insurance
(regardless of the visa type) for the duration of their visa or until they depart New Zealand, whichever comes first. The University of Auckland's preferred insurance policy for international students is Studentsafe-University. The Studentsafe insurance fee will be charged to a student's account 48-72 hours after enrolment.

degree_levels: 本校大二以上/碩一以上
eligibility:
一般組
本校大二以上/碩一以上
(不含博士生)
學生。（以報名交換學生甄選時，本校教務處學籍系統上之年級為準），Required completion of two semesters of full-time tertiary study outside South Africa。
TOEFL iBT 79 (讀 18 聽 17 說 20 寫 17 不接受 Home Edition) 或 IELTS 6.5 (聽 6.0 讀 6.0 寫  6.0 說  6.0) 或 全民英檢中高級，Some departments may required higher language proficiency。
不接受醫學院、管理學院會計學系、管理學院會計學研究所、公共衛生學院之學生申請。
